sections.title: Why this module matters
sections.body: REST API interview questions are core to every Java backend role — RESTful constraints, HTTP semantics and status codes, idempotency, request/response design, error handling, validation, pagination (cursor vs offset), HATEOAS, API versioning, OpenAPI/Swagger, HTTP clients (RestTemplate, WebClient, Feign), HTTP caching (ETag, Cache-Control), and Spring MVC controller fundamentals. For GraphQL-specific questions see the dedicated GraphQL page; for gRPC see the gRPC page.

sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
REST = a **set of constraints** over HTTP — not the sole way to design APIs, but the senior interview default.

- **Resources** are nouns; **verbs** map to HTTP methods (`GET` / `POST` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE`).
- **Statelessness** — every request stands alone.
- **Idempotency** — `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE` should be safe to retry.
- **Status codes** — 2xx success, 3xx redirect, 4xx client, 5xx server; pick the *most specific*.
- **Pagination** — cursor over offset for stable paging.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:
The interview surface for this module breaks into these focus areas:

- **Api design** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Comparisons** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.

- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **PUT vs PATCH** — full replace vs partial; PATCH is typically merge-patch.
- **HATEOAS** — pure REST principle; in practice, OpenAPI replaced it for most teams.
- **Idempotency keys** — the modern way to deduplicate retries on POST.
- **Versioning** — URL path (most common) > header > query; commit to one.
- **Error model** — RFC 7807 problem+json or a documented envelope; *be consistent*.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd model `/resources` as plural nouns, use <PUT | POST + idempotency-key> for safe retries, page via cursor, document the schema with OpenAPI, and standardise errors with problem+json. Versioning lives in the URL path because <ops simplicity / cache friendliness>."*
